U.S. Department of Energy (2006). Improving Pumping System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, Second Edition. Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy, Industrial Technologies Program, with the Hydraulic Institute; prepared by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Resource Dynamics Corporation and the Alliance to Save Energy; produced by NREL. DOE/GO-102006-2079, May 2006.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 4). A guidance sourcebook: few technology-level numbers. Main file: centrifugal pump BEP efficiency 35->90% (p.9), in-service pump efficiency 50-60% or lower (Tip Sheet #4, p.109), VFD efficiency 95-97% (p.54), pumping system lifespan 15-20 yr (p.63). No system-level percentage savings per measure, no costs per kW and no lifetimes per measure are printed; measures with numbers are the Appendix C tip-sheet worked examples (Oct 2005 tip sheets, 5 cents/kWh, price year not stated) and the affinity-law impeller-trimming rule, in _measures. Statistics (27% of manufacturing motor electricity, degradation 10-25%) in _other-values. Figures (pump curves, Fig. 1 of Tip Sheet #9 cost chart) not read. Several tip sheets are listed as in development and not included.
